description: Cron parse, humanize and next N runs — Parses a POSIX 5-field or Quartz 6/7-field cron expression (plus macros @yearly/@monthly/@weekly/@daily/@hourly), returns a plain-English summary and the next N scheduled runs in a given IANA timezone, and reports if the expression never fires or lands on a DST-ambiguous wall-clock. Handles step syntax, named months and days, Quartz '?'/L/W/# extensions, and the POSIX dom-OR-dow rule when both fie

after.description: ISO-8601 instant: find runs strictly after this. Defaults to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

count.description: How many future runs to return, 1-50. Default 5.

expression.description: The cron expression or macro, e.g. '*/15 9-17 * * 1-5' or '@weekly'.

flavor.description: Which cron dialect. Defaults to posix (5 fields) or quartz (6/7 fields) based on token count.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'. Defaults to UTC.

name: cron-explain
